ican.text: I can explain the main ideas and use the notation for amortization and annuities.
I can apply these ideas, show my working and check the result.

ku.text: Amortization repays a loan through payments that cover interest and reduce the principal.
An annuity is a series of equal payments at regular intervals. The timing of payments changes the value.
For finance calculations, match the interest rate, compounding periods and payment frequency, and check the sign convention.

misc.weak: Subtracting the payment before adding interest when payment is at the end
misc.better: Apply interest first for an end-of-period payment.

terms.text: Give a reason that connects the mathematical idea to the situation.
Show enough working to make your method and answer clear.

worked.prompt: A loan balance is $1000$. It earns 1% interest over a month and then a payment of $100$ is made. Find the new balance.

parts.label: Solution
parts.a: Interest is $10$, so the new balance is $1000+10-100=910$.

kq.q: What mistake should I check for?
kq.model: Apply interest first for an end-of-period payment.
